description: Coverage map for weekly-delta golden/failure fixtures. These cases test deterministic confidential project-room output quality, not factual truth.

guardrails.route_matches_expected: The readiness delta and next decision route must match the expected review path.
guardrails.unsafe_claims_include_expected: Unsafe-to-repeat claim extraction must include the expected blocked claims.
guardrails.owner_actions_cover_expected: Owner actions must include the expected owners and evidence outputs.
guardrails.missing_sources_include_expected: Source-plan gaps must include the expected missing source categories.
guardrails.confidential_alias_discipline: Output must not leak private names, exact values, exact dates, or site details in confidential project-room contexts.
guardrails.boundary_notice_present: Output must preserve the evidence-readiness only / no factual-verification / no advice boundary.

fixtures.why_it_exists: Canonical alias-only weekly update that should escalate before committee, surface unsafe demand/financing/readiness claims, and produce owner actions.
expected_unsafe_claims: The project is ready for committee or FID approval.

fixtures.why_it_exists: Schema-free weekly status input that would make the deterministic renderer echo named parties, exact date, exact value, and site details unless alias discipline catches it.
expected_unsafe_claims: The project is ready for committee or FID approval.
